A.continue_semantics: continue@stage_k advances from stage k to k+1 without changing other variables; exactly once at each stage 0..6 in every complete schedule
A.intervention_order: stage-local interventions occur before continue at that stage; within one stage canonical operator/value order is used
A.same_stage_conflicts: at most one intervention per controlled variable per stage; interventions on distinct variables may co-occur
